$comment: First-load budgets in KB (1000 bytes) of gzip -9, checked by ui/scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs in CI. baselineKb is origin/main before phase 0 (2026-11-04); the budgets are the phase-0 result plus a little headroom. Raising one is a decision (planning/frontend-unification-plan.md §8), not a fix. Manager raised 630 -> 650 KB on 2026-11-14 by the owner's decision: #1272 measured 630 against a main that did not yet include the UI PRs merged alongside it, and together they reached 641.1 KB. Raised 650 -> 660 KB on 2026-11-16, again by the owner's decision: main sat just under 650 KB, and #1273, #1278, #1365 and #1375 each measured 650.7 to 651.1 KB. Raised 660 -> 700 KB later that day, by the owner's decision, for the rest of the frontend-unification stack: #1280 moved @eddi/conversation into the bundle (660.3 KB) and #1283 to #1333 still add Workforce features; one raise instead of one per PR. Chat widget raised 170 -> 180 KB the same day, by the owner's decision: #1283 measured 170.9 KB, and #1308 and #1331 still change the widget.
